comment: g7-diary-addon: diary list branch (D17, template not modified). Rendered only for diary boards; inserted next to the basic fallback branch, whose condition excludes diary. No lifecycle here: the engine runs a node's own onMount even when its `if` is false (DynamicRenderer effect), so the diary API calls live in the child below, which mounts only inside this branch (D130, same shape as the template's auth/_redirect_if_logged_in).
name: Div

children.comment: Empty node that loads the diary data on diary boards only: summary API and the panel month calendar (wide screens — the month of the date filter, else this month).
